name: 三界神话「嘉峪关」
english_description: A mythology-themed mudlib set across the 'Three Realms' cosmology, distinct in its underlying codebase from the similarly-named sjcs (Legend of the Three Realms) despite the overlapping title. New characters set out from the South City Inn and choose from six unusually fantasy-flavored classes — swordsman, mage, terminator, elf, barbarian, or dark hell emissary — a broader genre mashup than the typical wuxia sect system. Registration sets up both an everyday login password and a separate recovery password, and the game has its own built-in anti-flood measures: a 60-second logout cooldown for regular accounts and rate-limiting on rapid reconnects.
